meta.title: Session calendar
meta.description: Adds **one button, 'Session calendar'** (rounded, a faint brand-blue wash with the calendar mark) below the 'Free session' row; it opens a small calendar beside the sidebar with a full-width **First / Latest switch** under the month title — First files a session on the day its first conversation happened, Latest on the day you last messaged it, and the choice is remembered. A day lists its sessions grouped by their workspaces, and the day frames and dots take the workspace colours involved (a gradient when several). Clicking a row opens that session and leaves the calendar open. Entry: the 'Session calendar' button in the left sidebar; inside the calendar use ‹ › to page months, 'Today' to return, and × to close, and (with focus in the card) the arrow keys to move a day or a week. Usage: click a date, read the day's sessions grouped in sidebar order (title plus the active rule's time), then click any row to open it; clicking outside or pressing Esc also dismisses. Turning the plugin off removes the button and the window and leaves DSH sessions, workspaces, and their order untouched. Data: reads only bounded slices of this machine's session logs (the session object's creation time and the first user message at the head); 'Latest' reuses DSH's own session summary `updatedAt`; titles and grouping come from the page's existing session and workspace data, nothing is uploaded, no session is written, and command or status records are excluded from ordering; days follow the browser's local time zone; subagent, blank, and archived sessions are hidden by the sidebar's rules; workspace colours are assigned in registry order from an eight-colour family; the button follows the New-session row's visibility.
